title: Electronic Spices 62mm x 42mm 2V 100mAh Rectangle Shape Polycrystalline Mini Epoxy Solar Panels (Pack of 1)
description: The 62mm x 42mm 2V 100mAh Rectangle Shape Polycrystalline Mini Epoxy Solar Panels are compact, efficient, and versatile solar energy harvesting solutions. These solar panels are designed with high-quality polycrystalline materials, ensuring the efficient conversion of sunlight into electrical energy. With a voltage output of 2V and a capacity of 100mAh, they provide a steady and reliable power source for various applications. Measuring 62mm x 42mm, these solar panels are compact and lightweight, making them suitable for a wide range of projects where space is a consideration. The square form allows for smooth integration into specific surfaces and systems. The solar panels have a durable epoxy coating that complements their resistance to environmental factors such as moisture, dirt, and corrosion. This guarantees an extended lifespan and dependable performance, even in difficult situations. Mini Epoxy Solar Panels provide a reliable and sustainable answer for solar electricity programs. Whether used for DIY projects, instructional functions, or powering small devices, these solar panels offer an efficient and green electricity supply
